title: To make the Kingswood's grief-bargain option actually appear at Garrow's, I had to redundantly re-run the same two conversations via 'argue him out of the warrant' and 'argue him off the coppice' after already brokering — each attempt (including one natural-1 fail) cost more Crown/Ironbound standing on top of what brokering had already spent, so the diplomatic Envoy solution ended up costing MORE net reputation than just brute-forcing the two persuasion checks would have.
where: The Verderer's Post (Colm) / The Ironbound Weigh-House (Marrick)
